profile.summary:
🚀 Technical Consultant | Software Solutions Delivery Expert | React JavaScript Developer 🚀

Passionate about navigating the intricate landscape of software development, I thrive as a versatile professional proficient in the entire Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC). As a seasoned React JavaScript developer, meticulous tester, and astute analyst, I specialize in solving complex problems with a holistic approach.

🌐 Key Skills:

SDLC Management
Building Strong Client Relationships
Influencing and Leading Cross-Functional Teams
Product Management and Backlog Creation
Cloud Infrastructure Expertise
Requirements Gathering and Analysis
UX/UI Design
Comprehensive Testing Strategies
Deployment and Bug Triage
Crafting Intuitive and Accessible Software
React JavaScript Development
Fostering Innovation in Solutions
Delivery Process Optimization
Collaboration Advocate
👩‍💻 React JavaScript Development:
Proficient in leveraging the power of React to build robust and scalable front-end solutions, I bring a dynamic skill set to the development process, ensuring an enhanced user experience and seamless interaction.

🤝 What Sets Me Apart:
I excel in translating client and user needs into actionable solutions, employing a data-driven approach to ensure optimum results. My knack for setting and achieving goals, coupled with the ability to build trust, establishes a solid foundation for successful project delivery.

🚀 Why Collaborate With Me:
As a React JavaScript developer, I bring not only technical expertise but also a deep understanding of user-centric design principles. I am committed to accessibility and intuitive design, ensuring that the end product resonates seamlessly with users.

💡 Let's Innovate Together:
I am driven by a passion for innovation, consistently seeking opportunities to improve processes and deliver outstanding results. If you are looking for a collaborative partner with a proven track record in delivering exceptional software solutions, let's connect and explore the possibilities!

#TechnicalConsultant #SoftwareDelivery #SDLC #ProductManagement #CloudInfrastructure #ReactJSDeveloper #InnovationLeader #CollaborationExpert

positions.locationName: Sydney, New South Wales, Australia · Hybrid

positions.title: Senior Technical Consultant, Application Developer
positions.description:
In my role at IBM's Data and Technology Transformation consulting arm, I provided client-focused leadership for a strategically significant Telecom project and played a central role in an ERP transformation for the Australian Defence Force, IBM Consulting's largest client.

Client-Focused Technical Leadership - Serving as the primary front-end engineer, I guided the development team through the SDLC, making critical design decisions with the client for a successful React-based web application with a complex codebase.

Full-stack Development - Leveraged JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, and Java, and utilized tools such as React, Jest, CouchDB, Docker, and REST APIs.

Code Quality - Implemented effective Git branching and merging practices, and conducted code reviews, enforcing code quality.

Collaborative Product Management - Identifying innovative features, I optimized the product backlog, ensuring clear documentation for Agile practices and alignment with client objectives.

Agile Process Enhancement - Collaborating with the PMO and the client, I enhanced the discovery-to-deployment process, employing Jira, and Agile practices and workshops to streamline project efficiency.

Strategic Project Orchestration - As Cutover Coordinator, I formulated a schedule for a project with 300+ team members and 2500+ tasks, ensuring a smooth transition while considering resource limitations and technical constraints.

Risk Management and Issue Resolution - I actively identified, documented, disseminated, monitored, and resolved issues within a comprehensive register, contributing to effective risk management.

Effective Communication and Facilitation - Facilitating workshops with clients, I captured and refined requirements and showcased developer outputs, demonstrating strong communication and collaboration skills.

UI/UX Design - I created Figma UI designs in collaboration with clients, ensuring intuitive logical flow, consistency, innovation, and accessibility.

positions.title: Technical Consultant
positions.description:
As an integral member of the Blockchain Consulting Team, I collaborated with high-profile FinTech, Telecom, and LawTech clients, serving as a blockchain expert, strategic consultant, and full-stack developer to facilitate the seamless adoption of this emerging technology.

Strategic Consulting - Collaborated with high-profile clients to research, design, and develop Blockchain-based business cases, providing strategic insights.

Software Implementation - Completed feature development for a visible blockchain project, showcasing expertise in both strategic and technical aspects. Engineered comprehensive full-stack features within a complex codebase, harnessing React, TypeScript, Javascript, HTML, CSS, REST APIs, Express, Node.js, Kubernetes, Docker, Java, and Blockchain.

Product Design and Research - Utilized research to shape product backlogs, ensuring alignment with user needs and market demands, pivotal for securing investments.

DevOps Optimization - Established robust development environments with CI/CD pipelines, streamlining and expediting the deployment process.

Client Collaboration - Facilitated design thinking workshops and led Scrum ceremonies in close collaboration with clients.

Project Management with Jira - Efficiently managed Jira workspaces for effective project tracking and management.

positions.title: Student Mentor
positions.locationName: Sydney, New South Wales, Australia · On-site
positions.description:
Served as a mentor for over 100 students in WEIT (Women in Engineering and IT) and Galuwa programs, catering to female and Indigenous high school students, respectively, with an interest in engineering.
Organized and conducted workshops covering coding, robotics, and design thinking.
Delivered speeches at both internal and external events to promote student engagement in STEM fields.
Provided personalized guidance and motivation, nurturing students' practical skills and fostering their educational and career aspirations.

volunteerExperiences.description: I volunteered as both a Biomedical Engineer and ICT Engineer to mentor a group of indigenous students from rural high schools for two days whist we participated in problem solving engineering workshops and industry visits. I enjoyed watching the students be intrigued by the activities and discuss with them what they wanted to do in their future whist hopefully providing them with some insight into studying engineering. Each student's perspective and goals were difference and I helped them relate those goals to the activities we were doing and the various jobs Engineering and IT can lead to.
